“你们几个竟敢背叛本公子，绝对没有好下场，本公子不会放过你们的，定要将你们千刀万剐不可！”
他怎么都没有想到，这些随从居然敢叛变，这让他恼羞成怒，暴跳如雷。
闻言，剩下那三名随从顿时吓得不轻，身体都忍不住颤抖起来。
见状，锦袍男子露出得意的微笑，居高临下的道：“怎么样？知道害怕了吧？你们现在给本公子好好的磕头赔罪，然后再杀了他们，将功折罪，本公子也不是小气的人，可以从轻处罚，给你们留一条全尸。”
听到这话，三名随从忍不住冷笑起来，这所谓的从轻处罚，真是一个天大的笑话。
“如果这就是公子所谓的开恩，那我们不稀罕！”
“从轻处罚都要以死谢罪，那和更重的惩罚有什么区别吗？”
“公子的如意算盘打的可真响啊，一边要我们替你卖命，另一边还想置我们于死地，当我们是傻子不成？！”
锦袍男子轻笑一声，不屑的道：“能给本公子卖命，是你们的福气，别不知好歹，要不然本公子让你们死无全尸，不入轮回！”
听到这话，那三名随从脸色煞白无比，浑身发冷，好歹也是相识一场，没想到公子非但不念旧情，还这般的狠毒，简直太冷血无情了。
苏长歌嗤笑一声，嘲讽道：“怪不得他们要叛变，你这也太狠了！”
锦袍男子袖子一甩，不满的道：“你懂什么？男人心不狠，站不稳，对待这些奴仆，就得这样才有效果。”
听到这话，那三名随从心里拔凉拔凉的，不敢对公子抱有一丝希望，求那年轻人或许有一线生机。
“前辈，求您大发慈悲，放我们一马吧，我们愿意为您，当牛做马，绝无怨言！”
“是啊，只要您留我们一命，我们做什么都可以。”
“为了表达我们的诚意，我们愿意将身上值钱的东西全部拿出来送给前辈！”
苏长歌笑了笑，说道：“你们这么容易叛变，我可不是敢不敢用你们，虽然你们也是迫不得已的，但事实就是如此。”
这句话无疑是给这三名随从浇了一盆冷水，他们顿时如泄了气的皮球一样变得无精打采。
苏长歌将他们的表情尽收眼底，淡淡一笑，道：“我身边不缺人，确实不会将你们留在身边，不过我愿意给你们一个求生的机会，只要你们帮我做一件事即可。”
闻言，三人的眼中露出一丝光亮，兴奋无比，纷纷拍着胸脯保证道：
“前辈有什么事，尽管吩咐，我们一定会尽心尽力的完成。”
“别说一件事了，就算是一百件，一千件都问题，包在我们身上。”
苏长歌微微一笑，说道：“你们先别急着答应，等我说出来你们再决定。”
“不知前辈要我们做什么事？”一名随从问道。
苏长歌指了指锦袍男子，开门见山的说道：“杀了他，不知你们敢不敢？你们不用着急回答，我给你们十个呼吸的功夫，你们慢慢想。”
闻言，三名随从凑到一起，小声的商议起来。
此刻，锦袍男子听到他们的对话，脸色很是难看。
他皱了皱眉头，不满的道：“他们可是我的随从，即使背叛了我，也绝对不可能反过来杀我，你就别白费功夫了！”
“是吗？我跟你的想法刚好相反。”苏长歌嗤笑一声，不以为然道。
他停顿了一下，面色淡然道：“在绝对的生死面前，没什么是不可能的，再说了，你平日里对他们又不好，哪来的自信觉得他们不会这么做？”
闻言，锦袍男子脸色越发苍白难看，虽然他不想承认，但不得不承认，对方的话虽然不中听，但是却很中肯。
苏长歌笑了笑，扫向三名随从，问道：“十个呼吸到了，你们考虑的怎么样了？”
一名随从回复道：“前辈，我们考虑好了，就听从前辈的安排，前辈给了我们一次重生的机会，我们没道理不答应。”

> Chapter 3835 Betrayal (Page 1)
"You guys dare to betray me, you will definitely not end well. I will not let you go, I will kill you with a thousand swords!"
He never expected that these followers would dare to rebel, which made him furious and furious.
Hearing this, the remaining three followers were immediately frightened, and their bodies could not help but tremble.
Seeing this, the man in brocade robes showed a proud smile and said condescendingly: "How is it? You know you are afraid, right? Now you can kowtow to me and apologize, and then kill them to make up for the crime. I am not a stingy person, so I can give you a lighter punishment and leave you a whole body."
Hearing this, the three attendants couldn't help but sneered. This so-called lighter punishment was really a big joke.
"If this is what you call mercy, then we don't care!"
"A light punishment requires death as an apology. Is that any different from a more severe punishment?"
"Young master's wishful thinking is really loud. On the one hand, you want us to work hard for you, but on the other hand, you want to put us to death. Do you think we are fools?!"
The man in brocade robes chuckled lightly and said disdainfully: "You are lucky to be able to work for me, don't be ignorant, otherwise I will let you die without your body intact and not enter reincarnation!"
Hearing this, the three attendants turned extremely pale and felt cold all over. They had met each other after all, but they didn't expect that the young master would not only not cherish their old friendship, but also be so vicious and ruthless.
Su Changge sneered and said mockingly: "No wonder they want to rebel, you are too cruel!"
The man in the brocade robe tossed his sleeves and said dissatisfied: "What do you know? Men are not ruthless and cannot stand firm. This is how you treat these slaves to be effective."
Hearing this, the three attendants were filled with chills and did not dare to have a glimmer of hope for the young master, hoping that the young man might have a chance of survival.
"Senior, please be merciful and let us go. We are willing to work as cows and horses for you without any complaints!"
"Yes, as long as you leave us alive, we can do anything."
"To express our sincerity, we are willing to give all the valuable things we have to our seniors!"
Su Changge smiled and said: "You are so easy to rebel. I don't dare to use you. Although you are forced to do so, it is the fact."
This sentence undoubtedly poured cold water on these three followers, and they suddenly became listless like deflated rubber balls.
Su Changge took in all their expressions, smiled faintly, and said: "There is no shortage of people around me, and it is true that I will not keep you by my side, but I am willing to give you a chance to survive, as long as you do one thing for me."
Hearing this, the eyes of the three people showed a glimmer of light, and they were extremely excited. They patted their chests and promised:
"Senior, if you have anything to do, just ask, and we will do our best to complete it."
"Don't talk about one thing. Even if it's a hundred or a thousand things, it's all a problem. It's all on us."
Su Changge smiled slightly and said, "Don't rush to agree, wait until I say it before you decide."
"I wonder what senior wants us to do?" one of the attendants asked.
Su Changge pointed at the man in brocade robes and said straight to the point: "Kill him, do you dare? You don't have to answer in a hurry. I'll give you ten breaths, and you can think about it slowly."
Hearing this, the three followers gathered together and discussed in a low voice.
At this moment, the man in brocade robe heard their conversation and his expression was very ugly.
He frowned and said dissatisfied: "They are my followers. Even if they betray me, they will never kill me in turn. Don't waste your efforts!"
"Really? I think exactly the opposite of you." Su Changge sneered and said disapprovingly.
He paused and said calmly: "In the face of absolute life and death, nothing is impossible. Besides, you don't treat them well on weekdays. How do you have the confidence to think that they won't do this?"
Hearing this, the man in brocade robes turned paler and uglier. Although he didn't want to admit it, he had to admit that although the other party's words were not pleasant to listen to, they were very pertinent.
Su Changge smiled, glanced at the three followers, and asked: "Ten breaths have arrived, what have you been thinking about?"
One of the followers replied: "Senior, we have thought about it and will follow your arrangements. Senior has given us a chance to be reborn. We have no reason not to agree."
